text: Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand [from judging the enemy]? Remove Your hand from Your chest, destroy them!
You have defined and established all the borders of the earth [the divisions of land and sea and of the nations]; You have made summer and winter.
Let not the oppressed return dishonored; Let the afflicted and needy praise Your name.
Do not forget the [clamoring] voices of Your adversaries, The uproar of those who rise against You, which ascends continually [to Your ears].
